metadata.title: Opportunities
metadata.description: AI Safety jobs, fellowships and research projects open to people in the Netherlands: based here, remote from the EU, or elsewhere in the EU. SAIN’s own projects first, everything else linked to its original posting.

sain.heading: SAIN projects
sain.intro: Research projects with a SAIN supervisor, through the Project Hub. Voluntary, remote-friendly and open for applications at any time.

external.heading: Jobs and fellowships at other organisations
external.intro: Collected once a day from the <link>{source} job board</link> and narrowed to roles someone in the Netherlands can take.
external.empty: No listings from other organisations right now.
external.note: SAIN does not select or check these listings and plays no part in the applications. Check the posting itself for the deadline, who can apply and any visa requirements.

close.heading: Not there yet? Start with a free course.
close.body: SAIN’s courses and the Project Hub are built to give you the background these roles ask for. Every programme is free.
